summary: PIMCO Corporate & Income Opportunity Fund filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market common share offering through JonesTrading, with a maximum sales commission but no guarantee any shares will sell. The supplement restates unified management fees of 0.65% of average daily net assets, leverage via reverse repurchase agreements averaging 17.62% of managed assets at a 3.934% weighted average cost, and 590,248 dividend reinvestment plan shares issued between July 1 and August 31, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch NAV dilution and ATM pace.
